messages:
Mina: ok who left a glorious clicky keyboard on the lounge couch this morning? it's like a tiny typewriter from another timeline.
Omar: not me. but i heard it played the theme of triumph when someone sat down. true story.
Gina: i tapped one key and my PR merged by itself (probably coincidence). calling it the Keyboard of Destiny.
Luis: legendary. we should give it a backstory: forged in the fires of last hackathon, blessed by two interns.
Mina: naming poll: "Keyboard of Destiny", "Clacktron 3000", "The Merge Maestro"
Omar: :thumbsup: Keyboard of Destiny
Gina: :tada: Clacktron 3000
Luis: :heart: The Merge Maestro
Reacji Bot: added :keyboard_of_destiny: emoji (reaction: :sparkles:)
Mina: vote tally says Keyboard of Destiny. new tradition: brief ritual before big releases. offerings accepted in the form of quality coffee.
Gina: ritual script drafted: three clicks for courage, two escape presses for humility, bow for continuous delivery.
Omar: suggestion: tiny sticker for laptops that says "Touched the Keyboard of Destiny". 25-run?
Luis: also idea: if you unplug it you must bring snacks. it's a delicate instrument of fate.
Mina: can we add a line to onboarding: "Respect The Keyboard: do not remap keys without consent"
Gina: i will design a minimalist sticker this weekend. white on black, tiny laurel wreath around a spacebar.
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Keyboard of Destiny lore + sticker plan"
Omar: future hires: be warned. the keyboard may whisper commit messages, but it also judges your indentation.
Luis: highly recommend documenting proper offering etiquette. coffee only, no Red Bull sacrifices.
Mina: who wants to be the official Keeper? responsibilities: monitor battery, ensure cable tidiness, log offerings.
Gina: i volunteer as co-keeper (design duties).
Omar: i will handle offerings log in the shared sheet.
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Keeper roster: Gina (design), Omar (log)"
Luis: this thread is officially lore. may our builds be swift and our keycaps uniform.
Mina: long live the Keyboard of Destiny :sparkles:
